summary: Monday's open looks set to be steered by global tech nerves and fresh inflation worries at home, with steady foreign buying the main cushion for Indian stocks.

detail.tone: A look-ahead to Monday 16 November. A quiet Saturday so far: no policy news and no special session; the one addition is that Nvidia's Friday slide deepened after a broker downgrade.
